handoff.summary: Implemented a pure prompt-stress CSV manifest adapter that maps CSV rows into existing PromptCase/NewPromptCase import records while preserving the CUIPP JSON path.
implementation_summary: Added PromptStressCsvImportRequest and import_prompt_stress_csv_manifest in adapter.rs.

Implemented strict CSV parsing for quoted commas/newlines, escaped quotes, BOM/CRLF handling, duplicate headers, uneven rows, duplicate case IDs, invalid segments, trailing characters after quoted fields, and all-or-nothing malformed-row errors.

Mapped prompt-stress CSV rows to prompt_stress cases with identity_judgement_allowed=false, prompt_quality_review_allowed=true, stable source_case_id from CSV case_id, portable image refs, source_manifest_ref validation, row hashes, row numbers, headers, and unmapped columns in hardcore_fields.
Extended CASE_IMPORTED EventLedger payload with source_system, source_iteration_id, source_recipe_id, and compact CSV lineage fields when CSV metadata is present.
Updated prompt-feedback module scope comment so CSV import is no longer listed as deferred; LoRA training remains out of scope.

proof_commands.result: PASS: 1 passed, 0 failed; DB-backed CSV import persisted PromptCases and EventLedger CSV lineage.
PASS: 1 passed, 0 failed; CUIPP JSON mapping regression remains green.
PASS: 1 passed, 0 failed; malformed CSV/ref inputs reject without partial import.

review_resolution: Pre-review concerns addressed: no naive CSV split; no Cargo dependency widening; prompt-stress segment is forced/validated; row-order-independent source IDs; malformed rows are all-or-nothing; JSON path remains covered.
Post-review HIGH fixed: trailing characters after a quoted CSV field now reject with row/column error and test coverage.
Post-review MEDIUM fixed: image_ref now reuses the portable-ref boundary at adapter time and rejects artifact:// or dataset:// values containing machine-local paths with row/column context.
Post-review lineage gap fixed: CSV source_manifest_ref and row_hash are persisted in hardcore_fields and mirrored into CASE_IMPORTED payload; test asserts both.
Post-review source_manifest_ref gap fixed: raw machine path manifest refs reject before persistence and are covered by malformed-input test.
Scope review broad dirty-worktree and palmistry Cargo findings are pre-existing/unrelated to MT-052; scoped status for MT-052 paths shows only the three allowed files modified.
